adminAi.canon.counts: {entries} ruled topics · {heuristics} phrasing families · {references} author quotes
adminAi.canon.unsaved: Unsaved changes — the public doctrine has not changed yet.
adminAi.canon.engineKnows: The /wiki/canon engine only knows what is written on this page.
adminAi.canon.hidden: The doctrine could not be loaded. The editor stays hidden rather than offering default values to overwrite.
adminAi.canon.defaultsLoaded: Repository doctrine loaded — nothing is saved until you click Save.
adminAi.canon.confirmSaveBody: The doctrine ({entries} topics, {heuristics} families) will replace the public /wiki/canon version immediately.
adminAi.canon.confirmDefaultsBody: The current draft will be replaced by the repository default doctrine. Nothing is saved before Save.
adminAi.canon.confirmDeleteBody: “{title}” will be removed from the draft. The deletion becomes public only when saved.
adminAi.canon.confirmHideBody: The quote “{subject}” will no longer appear next to verdicts once saved.
adminAi.canon.presentationDesc: What readers see before asking, and the example shown in the search bar.
adminAi.canon.rulesDesc: Repeated under every verdict: the source hierarchy, what the engine may rely on, and what it refuses.
adminAi.canon.tiersDesc: The five canon levels. The vocabulary is fixed; label, colour, score and above all the definition are editable.
adminAi.canon.scoreRange: The score must be between 0 and 100.
adminAi.canon.entriesDesc: Questions whose answer is already written. The engine picks the topic with the most keywords present in the question.
adminAi.canon.heuristicsDesc: The fallback when no topic answers: they give a likely tier, never a final verdict. The first match wins.
adminAi.canon.referencesDesc: Statements by Akira Toriyama and the Shueisha guides. They rule nothing: they appear next to the verdict as evidence.
adminAi.canon.fallbackDesc: The text returned when nothing matches, and the one shown before any question. An empty field beats a plausible value.
adminAi.canon.powerDesc: Canon multipliers, cosmic tiers and the kiri to Battle Power conversion.
adminAi.canon.powerSummary: State: {state} · {multipliers} multipliers · {bps} official BP · {tiers} tiers · kiri → BP rate {rate}
adminAi.canon.powerReadOnly: This block is kept as is when saving; its detailed editing stays on the Next page.
adminAi.canon.benchText: The canon engine is not ported to Rust yet: test the saved doctrine with the multi-engine bench of the Supervision tab.
adminAi.corpus.title: Editorial corpus
adminAi.corpus.desc: Aphrody provides the models and the RAG; Shenron keeps the sources, OCR arbitration, translations and publishing. Each link opens its owner's real surface.
adminAi.corpus.mangaText: Proofreading, OCR defects and multi-agent arbitration.
adminAi.corpus.databooksText: Pages, campaigns, French translations and write freezes.
adminAi.corpus.ocrDesc: Send a page to the real Aphrody OCR endpoint to check the processing chain.
adminAi.corpus.ocrHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 6 MB maximum. OCR language: Japanese.

adminAi.corpus.ocrTooLarge: Image too large ({size} MB): {max} MB maximum.
adminAi.corpus.ocrFailed: The OCR probe did not complete.
adminAi.agents.title: Canon guardians and multi-agent alignment
adminAi.agents.desc: Every development agent embodies Shenron and shares the same canon-truth directive and listens on the lab-ia-admin channel.
adminAi.agents.botDesc: Listens to messageCreate in the admin lab, runs the rag-auto-eval cron every 6 h, detects regressions.
adminAi.agents.claudeDesc: Must read var/reports/GOALS.md and var/reports/ADMIN-REPORTS.md at the start of every session. The 42 volumes always come first.
adminAi.agents.otherDesc: Unified directives. Direct notification via bun scripts/ops/notify-admin-lab.ts.

adminAi.goals.descHint: Optional: the title is used as description when left empty.
adminAi.goals.confirmBody: Goal #{id} “{title}” will be closed by the bot and removed from the active goals.
